dish: house-made pasta, 6-hour red sauce, lasagna, prime rib
address: 211 E Main St, West Jefferson, OH 43162
w: A West Jefferson institution on the old National Road since 1950 — 75-plus years of family-run Italian, pasta made in house and a red sauce simmered a minimum of six hours. The long-running Columbus food blog CMH Gourmand profiled it, and it's a perennial name on Columbus Underground's community 'great/cheap Italian' threads. Measured: #1 of 19 West Jefferson restaurants on Tripadvisor. Live music the last Tuesday of each month.

dish: prime rib, home-cooked tavern fare in a historic stagecoach inn
w: A genuine National Road landmark still serving dinner — built 1836–37 in Lafayette and reputed to be Ohio's second-oldest stagecoach inn, host to six U.S. presidents (subject of an Ohio Historical Marker and National Road travel histories). Known today for prime rib and home-cooked specials. Open Tue–Sat (active listings, Aug 2026). Merit is the landmark itself; food is honest tavern fare.
